variants.headline: The colony has voted
variants.body: An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Ballots before the business of government
variants.body: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: An Assembly election enters the record
variants.body: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
